sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:1

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:1:1
items.html:
A secret within a secret, etc., for Atik Yomin, who is the most concealed Partzuf in Atzilut, while clothing within another secret, was made ready etc.: The explanation: there is a great difference in Atik from the rest of the Partzufim of Atzilut, because of the Malchut of AK, meaning the Malchut of the first restriction, which is hidden in his head, and is not revealed anymore in any of the Partzufim of Atzilut. As the ARI wrote above (page 618, item 24), in the secret of the verse, “The stone that the builders rejected has become the head stone of the corner.” For this Malchut is revealed only from the Rosh of Atik, and for that reason she is revealed as the head of the corner. This is the secret that there are only nine Sefirot in AA, and he lacks Malchut — meaning, only the Malchut of the discernment of the first restriction is not revealed in him, but rather the Malchut sweetened in the quality of mercy of the second restriction, which is regarded, in relation to the Malchut of the first restriction, like the Malchut of Bina, in the secret of the verse “and the two of them went.”
However, in truth, there is also in the Rosh of Atik the discernment of the Malchut of the second restriction, through which he bestows upon all the Partzufim of Atzilut, and she is regarded as the discernment of his middle line, and of his NHY. And therefore the ARI says that the Malchut is hidden in him, meaning, that he does not use her for the sake of the lower ones, and therefore she is regarded as the discernment of his left line, meaning the discernment of Gevura that is clothed in MoS [the concealed brain]. And this is the secret of Butzina de Kardinuta [the lamp of darkness] that is hidden in MoS. However, toward himself, certainly he does use her, for this is why the bottom two thirds of the lower ones of NH that are his extend to BYA, almost equally with the feet of AK — namely, like the SAG of AK before the second restriction, as is known.
And this is what the Zohar hints at: “A secret within a secret was prepared and made ready,” etc. For since the Rosh of Atik is very concealed from Atzilut, like the Partzufim of AK themselves, because of the bottom Hey of the first restriction hidden in him, as above — therefore “was prepared,” meaning that he clothed within another secret, namely in the discernment of the screen of the second restriction, which is the secret that raised the bottom Hey to the discernment of Einayim, and brought his AHP out; and these AHP became the two Roshim [pl. of Rosh] of AA, where Galgalta is the discernment of his Ozen [ear], and MoS is the discernment of his HP [Hotem and Peh]. And by this you will also understand what the ARI wrote above (page 630, item 34), that Atik is half of the upper Keter of BON, and AA is half — the lower Keter — study it there well. For Atik selected for himself only the discernment of Galgalta ve Einayim of the Keter of Nekudim, which served there at the time of the Katnut of Nekudim, in which no nullification whatsoever occurred, as written there. But the AHP of Keter, which rose and joined to his Rosh through the new light that breached the Parsa at the time of the Gadlut of Nekudim — those he brought out, and corrected and selected them in the secret of twelve months of Ibur [impregnation], for the sake of the two Reishin [heads] of AA. As the ARI wrote there.
And after Atik corrected the two Reishin of AA in the secret of the Ibur, as above, they were born and came out to their place, and then he clothed within them, as the ARI writes here; and by this he “was prepared” and the light of the Rosh of Atik expanded to the lower ones. And this is together with all the corrections that are drawn by means of this clothing, as the ARI continues before us.
